MedControl is an application that allows you to control and record your vital signs in an easy and orderly manner, as well as keep track of and remind you of your medication in a simple and very intuitive way.

Details of the App by sections:

-Calendar and Reminders: In this section you can enter your usual medication and generate reminders taking into account their administration hours; you will have the possibility to determine the dose, the frequency and make comments that may be useful. Another high-value feature in this section is the symptom calendar. In this section, you can record a symptom that you consider and specify its frequency, intensity, and write a note that can help interpret the record. The sequence of records will be reflected in the calendar.

-Blood pressure: In this section, the blood pressure values will be recorded and displayed in simple graphs for interpretation by your referring physician. The values will be exported in PDF format, providing the average daily and weekly pressures, which can be of great help in determining the need for treatment or further follow-up by your doctor.

-Glycemia: In this section, the daily blood glucose values will be recorded and organized in relation to meals, this allows you to make dose adjustments of your usual medication or determine possible triggers in case of worsening of your blood glucose values. The data will be displayed in simple and intuitive graphs and can be exported in PDF format for better interpretation.

-Temperature: With this functionality you can record your daily temperature values. They will be displayed in simple graphs and the data can be exported in PDF. -Heart Rate: In this section the daily heart rate values will be collected. They will be collected in simple graphs, easy to interpret and the values will be exported in PDF.
